decisions.reason: The source modifies only the bottle-and-sky design; the separate grill illustration retains its smoke-like slogan treatment and other requirements unchanged.
The source modifies only the bottle-and-sky design and does not change the separate requirement to stamp the slogan onto the meat.
The requested visual and label changes do not alter the production constraint requiring fully hand-drawn artwork.
The feedback concerns tortillas, steak streak placement, and stamped text in the separate meat illustration; it does not change the bottle-and-cloud design.

Although both illustrations contain steak and the same slogan, the source specifically changes the separate meat-and-stamped-slogan illustration and does not alter the grill illustration's contents, steak shape, smoke rendering, or readability.
The illustration adjustments do not change the required green-background and background-free PNG export variants or their applicable completed illustrations.
The requested visual revisions do not change the fully hand-drawn production-method constraint.
Message 34 modifies the steak shape and text readability of the distinct grill-and-smoke design; it does not change the bottle-and-cloud design.
The reference to steaks concerns the distinct grill-and-smoke design and does not alter the meat design's cartoon style or stamped-slogan presentation.
The requested visual revisions do not change the requirement that the artwork be produced without AI tools.
The source changes only which completed illustration requires background-variant PNG exports; it does not change the bottle illustration's design attributes or scope.

The existing final-delivery requirement already applies PNG and JPG formats to all illustrations. Requesting two PNG background variants for one additional illustration does not alter that general format requirement.
The source adds an illustration to the background-variant export obligation but does not change any grill-design attribute or scope.
The requested PNG background variants do not change the requirement that all illustrations be completed without AI tools.
The source concerns deliverable-file background variants and does not modify the meat illustration's visual style, slogan text, stamped presentation, or scope.
The visibility correction applies to the bottle within the standalone strawberry composition, not the separate bottle and cloud-slogan illustration.
The visibility correction applies to smoke within the standalone strawberry composition, not the separate grill illustration's smoke-rendered slogan.
The requirement that the bottle and smoke be fully visible does not change the artwork production-method constraint.
The source removes the specific "pineapple" text from the bottle in the standalone strawberry composition; it does not change the separate bottle illustration's required "Oxnard" label or slogan.
The grill illustration has no pineapple bottle text, and its smoke-rendered slogan remains unaffected by the source decision.
The meat illustration's stamped slogan is a separate text element and is not affected by removing "pineapple" from the bottle in the standalone strawberry composition.
